lines: The ten swords sparkled under the moonlight.
It was Hebiko who had gotten slightly pushed back. And Akitsu hadn't even used her full strength yet.
Just give up already and let me pass! I have more experience and even more arms than you, you get that, right?
We have fought on the same side before. I won't take your life!
Stop it, Akitsu-chan! Don't go easy on Hebiko. This is a serious fight between swordswomen. It's kill or be killed, that's it.
Do you want to get killed that badly? Then I'll give you what you wish for!
Akitsu's aura changed. Hebiko adjusted her grip on her swords with a serious look on her face.
Magick Gear Hexa-Blade Style! Hexagram Spread!!
A split second before Hebiko could unleash her special attack, her octopus tentacles were cut off and thrown through the air along with the swords they had been gripping.
It was Akitsu who screamed out in anguish.
Hyaah!? What's going on!!? So disgusting! They're stuck to me!!!
Hebiko's severed tentacles were tangling around Akitsu's slender arms, her legs, and even her face, which made it impossible for her to move.
Hebiko is a little hurt that you called them disgusting.
Even while crawling on the ground with basically only her torso, Hebiko managed to look up at Akitsu with a fearless look on her face.
Octopuses sever their own tentacles when running away.
And those severed tentacles regrow after a short whileー
You knew that, so you only aimed for Hebiko's tentacles. Didn't you, Akitsu-chan?
Hngh... So you made me cut off your legs on purpose!? Was that your plan from the beginning!?
Well, Hebiko can't move right away either though, so maybe this ends as a draw?
But, Fuma will be able to get awayーHaaa...
Akitsu sighed deeply and her murderous aura disappeared.
Jeez! Just this once! Since I wasn't able to save Fuma last time.
I'm only repaying that debt. There's no next time! Got it?!
I don't need your gratitude, just get these sticky things off me!
Sorry, Hebiko can't move right now... Can you stay like that for a while?
